Title: Question: VP with seating order change

Messages.Author: Lord Darksword
Messages.Body:
The seating order changes at the table. For Victory Point purposes,
does it apply to your origional prey or your new prey?

Messages.Author: Sorrow
Messages.Body:
> The seating order changes at the table. For Victory Point purposes,
> does it apply to your origional prey or your new prey?

Huh?
Ever person you oust that is your current prey at the time of their
ousting, you get a VP for.

Sorrow

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
> Ever person you oust that is your current prey at the time of their
> ousting, you get a VP for.

Correct. You get a VP every time someone is ousted while you are
seated to his or her right.
